title: Thermal Process Packages
summary: Integrated thermal process equipment packages for industrial heating, cooling, condensation, evaporation and concentration applications.
body:
Tongyang Process provides custom-engineered heat transfer equipment and coordinated thermal process packages for chemical and industrial applications.

Our equipment portfolio includes shell-and-tube heat exchangers, condensers, evaporators, reactors, pressure vessels and associated mechanical components.

We support equipment engineering, material selection, mechanical design coordination, fabrication and inspection based on project-specific process and operating requirements.

Package configurations are developed with consideration of thermal duties, operating conditions, utility requirements, materials, equipment interfaces and applicable design standards.
seoTitle: Heat Transfer & Thermal Process Packages | Tongyang Process
seoDescription: Custom heat transfer and thermal process equipment packages, including heat exchangers, condensers, evaporators and integrated industrial systems.
